name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: Taiwan tracked 3 Chinese military aircraft and 9 warships in the 24 hours to 24 Nov, after large early-November drills
state: Taiwan's defence ministry detected three Chinese warplanes and nine warships around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 24 Nov; all three aircraft crossed the median line, and it expects a Chinese satellite launched on 26 Nov to fly over its air defence zone (Taipei Times). A PLA exercise in early November at one point involved more than 100 naval and coast guard vessels (Taiwan News, 22 Nov). Activity has eased since then; no blockade, clash or severed channel was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: No change to travel advice for Taiwan; check FCDO travel advice before travelling. Shipping and chip supply chains remain sensitive to military activity in the Taiwan Strait.
rubric_hit: Watch: large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan in early Nov (100+ vessels); no blockade or clash

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
